features: LIBRA COLOUR SLEEPCOVER CASE – Made with recycled materials, personalize, and protect your Kobo Libra Colour
SLEEP & WAKE TECHNOLOGY – That wakes up your eReader automatically when you open the cover and sleeps when you close it – an efficient way to conserve the battery life on your device
PERSONALIZE YOUR EREADER –Personalize your Kobo Libra Colour with a pop of color – choose from Black, Butter Yellow, Dusk Blue, Garden Green Basic, Black Notebook, or Sand Beige Notebook

BUILT-IN IN 2 WAY STAND– That keeps your eReader upright for hands-free reading in landscape and portrait mode – an ultra-portable and convenient way that props up your Kobo Libra Colour. SleepCover is only compatible with the Libra Colour eReader
